brief.note: CoreWeave joins on AI debt fears and Perpetua on a precious metals rout; inflation data hit both.

candidates.name: CoreWeave, Inc.
candidates.business: Rents Nvidia GPU capacity to AI developers from its own data centres
candidates.cause: Yields on its 2032 bonds neared 15% as investors balked at debt-funded AI expansion, and Gartner warned many neocloud providers will fail by 2030.
candidates.right: AI demand keeps the contracts full and CoreWeave refinances before the interest burden bites
candidates.wrong: Financing costs outrun contract revenue and the debt leaves little for shareholders

candidates.name: Perpetua Resources Corp.
candidates.business: Developing a US gold project; no production or revenue yet
candidates.cause: Gold and silver prices fell hard after hot US inflation data, and pre-production developers dropped furthest; no company announcement accompanied the fall.
candidates.right: Gold steadies and the project advances toward permits with analyst targets far above the price
candidates.wrong: Gold keeps falling and a pre-production developer needs to raise money at low prices

candidates.name: T-Mobile US, Inc.
candidates.business: Runs the second-largest US mobile network, selling wireless and home broadband
candidates.cause: SpaceX agreed to buy a nationwide 800 MHz spectrum portfolio from Grain Management, setting up Starlink as a direct rival for US mobile customers.
candidates.right: Satellite capacity cannot match dense urban networks and Starlink stays a niche rural rival
candidates.wrong: Starlink wins mainstream subscribers and price competition compresses wireless margins for years

candidates.name: Alignment Healthcare, Inc.
candidates.business: Runs Medicare Advantage health plans for seniors across several US states
candidates.cause: CMS cut the 2027 star rating on its largest California contract to 3.5 from 4.0, costing bonus payments on about 75% of its Medicare Advantage members.

metrics.label: Other plans
metrics.value: Six of seven at 4 stars or better

candidates.right: The contract regains four stars at the next review and the bonus payments return
candidates.wrong: Lost bonus payments squeeze margins for two years while medical costs keep climbing
